review.posthog_relevance: Adds AWS Redshift as a supported warehouse integration, extending PostHog's warehouse connector capabilities.
review.reason: The change adds AWS Redshift support by updating the Django model choices, database migration, and migration version marker. This establishes the backend configuration and schema compatibility for the new warehouse type. No connector implementation or test assertions are supplied, so the tier is limited to configuration and metadata updates.
review.uncertainty: The tier is conservative because the actual data ingestion, query execution, and connector implementation are absent; the score reflects only the configuration and migration setup.
